curation_disposition: Reference grounding is retained here. Compound-specific primary review and exact subject joins remain open; no source-owned CARD assertion is rewritten from a reference match.

10.1128/jcm.00428-23.finding: The study distinguishes susceptible and resistant clinical isolates and reports multiple erm(55) deposits. A shared species and gene name do not select an experimental allele, prove causation, or resolve an isolate-specific UniProt assignment.

11408212.finding: The paper distinguishes CJ12 and CJ21. Current UniProt and ENA metadata pair AF338705 with CJ21 and AF338706 with CJ12. The figure caption lists the strains and accessions in opposite order without an explicit per-item mapping; positional matching is not used. Clinical-isolate and experimental-host observations remain separate.

12177341.access_limit: The observed publisher full-text link returned a tool internal error without an HTTP status; no full-text inspection or access-denial status is claimed.
12177341.finding: The abstract and accession footnote connect erm(36), Micrococcus luteus MAW843 and AF462611. The protein's current ermML name and erm36 synonym remain reference annotations; no exact experimental protein assignment is made.

1761231.access_limit: Publisher request returned 403; stopped without retry or bypass.
1761231.finding: The lrm reference has TK21 source context. The deposit also covers a different gene, so its shared archive is not a unique gene or allele identifier.

22475029.finding: The C. striatum type strain was susceptible to the tested antibiotics except cefotaxime. J7Q2T4 points to its partial ermX deposit, HE586307. This reference is not evidence that the type strain is macrolide resistant; no conclusion about all ErmX proteins follows.
locations: Results: Phenotypic characterisation and antibiotic susceptibility tests

37417762.finding: The study reports erm(56) in T. pyogenes and deposits OQ326498. Effects differ by host and compound: the E. coli pristinamycin IA comparison is inconclusive because the recipient was already poorly susceptible. A class label must not propagate a resistance claim across all compounds or hosts.

8067735.finding: The primary abstract names JIR100 as the ErmQ source. UniProt separately annotates another strain in a later genomic submission; that is not the original experimental subject.
